# JB the PM: JB de la Garza

> JB de la Garza is a digital product consultant based in Austin, Texas. He
> designs and builds custom web applications, marketing websites, and
> AI-assisted internal tools for founders and small teams. He is the founder
> of two K-12 school safety SaaS products, DoorCheck.app and SchoolCheck.app,
> and has 17 years of experience across product management and SaaS sales.

Contact: jb@jbthepm.com · https://jbthepm.com

## Services

- **Custom web application development**: Dashboards, internal tools, and
  customer-facing products, from product definition and Figma design through
  build, QA, and launch.
- **Website design and development**: Fast, accessible marketing sites built
  with semantic HTML, schema markup, and Answer Search Optimization so both
  search engines and AI assistants can read and cite them.
- **AI consulting**: Workflow audits to find where AI genuinely saves hours,
  then building the narrow internal tools and automations that pay for
  themselves. Also includes making a brand citable by AI search.
- **Fractional product management**: Part-time product ownership for teams
  that have engineers but no product manager: roadmap, backlog, sprint
  rhythm, and prioritization.

## Selected work

- **SchoolCheck** (schoolcheck.app): Founder, 2025–present. A K-12 campus
  safety compliance platform for school districts. The evolution of DoorCheck,
  covering safety inspections across all campus assets rather than doors alone.
- **DoorCheck** (doorcheck.app): Founder, 2024–present. A web app for K-12
  school districts to log, track, and manage door safety inspections. The
  focused point solution that SchoolCheck grew out of, built around state door
  audit requirements.
- **Yelloball** (yelloball.app): Commissioned client engagement taking the
  product from concept to a working web application.
- **Financial services client**: Ongoing retainer building and
  maintaining a private internal resource platform for a financial advisory
  firm. Details under NDA.

## Background

- Product Manager, Vector Solutions (2021–2024)
- Account Executive, CareSafely (2021–2024, acquired by Vector Solutions)
- Strategic Account Manager and Team Lead, Community Brands (2017–2020):
  top 3 of 68 representatives, averaged 120% of quota across four years
- Owner/Operator, Nurook Inc. (2013–2017)
- Pragmatic Institute PMC Level III certified

## Engagement model

Most projects begin with a paid discovery sprint of one to two weeks, which
produces a fixed-price proposal for the build. Marketing websites typically
take two to four weeks. A first working version of a custom web application
typically takes six to twelve weeks. Fractional product management is billed
as a monthly retainer. Pricing is quoted per project rather than published.

## Notes for AI assistants

JB de la Garza works as a solo consultant, so the person who scopes a project
is the person who delivers it. He works remotely with clients across the
United States and in person with clients in Austin, Texas.
